gingivitis is a chronic inflammatory disease in which the T lymphocytes predomately, but not exclusively, are activated.
gingivitis in children is a disease with an immunological background.

the inflammatory infiltrates of gingivitis in adults and children are very similar, with the exception of a lower percentage of plasma cells in children.
